title: Evidence Aging Framework — Time-Weighted Accuracy, Recency Windows, and Freshness Filtering

beforeS131.agingMethod: NONE — all-time aggregate accuracy with equal weight
beforeS131.pruningMethod: COUNT-BASED ONLY — sessions capped at 50, recommendations at 200
beforeS131.staleDataRisk: HIGH — answers from week 1 equal weight to yesterday
beforeS131.timeWeighting: Not present before S131; topicPerformance.accuracy was a simple correctCount/totalAttempts ratio across the entire session history
beforeS131.recencyClassification: No evidence windowing existed; all topics treated as equally current regardless of lastSeen

afterS131.formula: weightedSum / weightTotal where weight = exp(-lambda * age), lambda = ln(2) / (14 * 86400000)

formulaDerivation.weight: exp(-lambda * ageMs) — exponential decay, halving every 14 days
formulaDerivation.weightedSum: Σ (correct ? 1 : 0) * weight for all attempts on the topic
formulaDerivation.weightTotal: Σ weight for all attempts on the topic

recent.description: Most relevant evidence — lastSeen within past week

active.description: Still relevant, slightly discounted — lastSeen between 7 and 14 days ago

historical.description: Contextual, significantly discounted — lastSeen between 14 and 28 days ago

archived.description: Preserved for audit, minimal weight — lastSeen more than 28 days ago

afterS131.freshnessCheck: getFreshObservations(maxAgeDays) filters observations to those with evidence within the specified window (default 28 days). Strengths, weaknesses, misconceptions, and topicTrends are filtered by lastSeen timestamp; behaviorTrends are passed through unfiltered.

ageProperties.auditability: All raw data preserved in session history — every attempt with its timestamp remains in localStorage under the learner state object. The aging framework layers on top without mutating underlying data.

functions.name: _computeTimeWeightedAccuracy
functions.description: Computes EWMA accuracy with 14-day half-life for a given topic. Iterates all sessions and attempts, filtering by topic match, then applies exponential decay weighting based on attempt age. Returns null if no attempts exist, otherwise a 0-100 integer percentage.
keyDetails: Age clamped at zero: Math.max(0, now - timestamp) prevents negative age
Returns null (not 0) when no attempts exist — callers must handle null
functions.consumedBy: computeEvidenceGraph() — stored as evidence[topic].timeWeightedAccuracy alongside overall accuracy and recent accuracy

functions.name: getEvidenceWindows
functions.description: Classifies all topic evidence into four recency tiers based on lastSeen timestamp. Calls computeEvidenceGraph() internally, then partitions evidence into recent/active/historical/archived buckets.
keyDetails: Computes a fresh evidence graph each call (no caching)
Uses evidence[topic].lastSeen as the partition key
Cutoffs computed at call time from Date.now()
Each bucket value is a topic-indexed object of the full evidence entry

functions.name: getFreshObservations
functions.description: Filters the observation registry to only include observations where the underlying topic evidence is within maxAgeDays (default 28). Strengths, weaknesses, and topicTrends are filtered by topic's lastSeen; misconceptions by their own lastSeen; behaviorTrends pass through unfiltered.
keyDetails: Pre-builds an evidenceAge lookup map keyed by topic
Topic-based observations (strengths, weaknesses, topicTrends): filtered by evidenceAge[topic] >= cutoff
Behavior trends: passed through unfiltered (no topic linkage)
Returns: { strengths, weaknesses, misconceptions, topicTrends, behaviorTrends } — same shape as observation registry

computeEvidenceGraph.role: Central evidence hub — calls _computeTimeWeightedAccuracy for every topic and stores timeWeightedAccuracy alongside overall accuracy and recent accuracy in the evidence map

_deriveObservations.role: Converts evidence map into classified observations (strengths/weaknesses/misconceptions/etc.), consumed by getFreshObservations for recency filtering

safetyNote: Older evidence remains visible and auditable. Weighting affects interpretation only — no evidence is lost. The EWMA produces a recency-aware summary; raw correctCount/totalAttempts remain accessible via evidence[topic].accuracy and evidence[topic].recentAccuracy. This is NOT prediction; it is a recency-aware summary of past performance. All raw data is preserved in session history within localStorage.
